Author: aethel-tail
Name: Graphics Upscaler Toggle
Punchline: Re-engages DLSS on login (guarded display re-apply)
Description: Re-applies the game's display settings on login so the DLSS feature is properly re-created — that is what re-engages DLSS and lets upscaler proxies such as OptiScaler take over — while a window guard keeps the game from dropping the window frame style during the apply. Works around the bug where DLSS doesn't properly engage on initial load and requires a manual toggle.
